questions.title: Length and Boundary Characters
questions.description:
Read one word and report its size and boundary letters: print the number of characters in the word, then its first character, then its last character, each on its own line.

Input Format:
A single line containing one word without spaces.

Output Format:
Line 1: the length of the word.
Line 2: the first character.
Line 3: the last character.

Constraints:
1 <= length of word <= 1000, word contains only lowercase letters
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length of word <= 1000, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Case Conversion of a Word
questions.description:
Read one word and print it twice: first entirely in uppercase, then entirely in lowercase, each on its own line.

Input Format:
A single line containing one word without spaces (letters only, any mix of cases).

Output Format:
Line 1: the word in uppercase.
Line 2: the word in lowercase.

Constraints:
1 <= length of word <= 1000, letters only

questions.title: Extract a Substring by Index
questions.description:
Read a word and two indices start and end. Print the part of the word that begins at index start (included) and stops at index end (not included). Remember that substring(2, 5) gives the characters at indices 2, 3 and 4.

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated values: the word, then the integer start, then the integer end.

Output Format:
Print one line: the extracted substring.

Constraints:
0 <= start < end <= length of word, word has no spaces

questions.title: Frequency of a Target Character
questions.description:
Read a word and a target character. Count how many times the target character appears anywhere in the word and print that count.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated values: the word (no spaces) and the target character.

Output Format:
Print one line: the number of occurrences of the target character.

Constraints:
1 <= length of word <= 1000, word and target contain only lowercase letters
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length of word <= 1000, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Replace All Occurrences of a Letter
questions.description:
Read a word, an original character and a replacement character. Print the word with every occurrence of the original character replaced by the replacement character. Use the replace method that takes two characters (no regular expressions).

Input Format:
A single line with three space-separated values: the word, the character to replace, and the replacement character.

Output Format:
Print one line: the modified word.

Constraints:
1 <= length of word <= 1000, all characters are lowercase letters
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length of word <= 1000, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Which Word Comes First
questions.description:
Read two words and decide their dictionary (lexicographic) order using compareTo. Print first if the first word comes earlier in dictionary order, second if the second word comes earlier, or equal if the words are identical.

Input Format:
A single line with two space-separated words, each without spaces.

Output Format:
Print one line: first, second or equal.

Constraints:
1 <= length of each word <= 100, words contain only lowercase letters
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length of each word <= 100, lowercase letters only

questions.title: Username Validator
questions.description:
A signup form must reject weak usernames. A username is valid when its length is between 6 and 12 (both included) AND it contains at least one underscore character. Read the username and print valid or invalid.

Input Format:
A single line containing one username without spaces (letters, digits and underscores only).

Output Format:
Print one line: valid if the username passes both rules, otherwise invalid.

Constraints:
1 <= length of username <= 100
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length of username <= 100, letters digits and underscores only

questions.title: Product Code Formatter
questions.description:
A warehouse scanner emits product codes wrapped in stray spaces. Clean the raw line by trimming leading and trailing spaces, then print the code in uppercase. Spaces inside the code (if any) must be kept.

Input Format:
A single line containing the raw product code, possibly with leading and trailing spaces (read the whole line).

Output Format:
Print one line: the trimmed code converted to uppercase.

Constraints:
1 <= length of raw line <= 200

questions.title: Initials From a Full Name
questions.description:
An email generator builds a person's initials from their full name. Read the full name (words separated by single spaces) and print the first character of every word joined together.

Input Format:
A single line containing 2 to 5 words separated by single spaces, each word starting with a letter.

Output Format:
Print one line: the initials, one character per word in order.

Constraints:
2 <= number of words <= 5, 1 <= length of each word <= 20, letters only

questions.title: Vehicle Plate Number Checker
questions.description:
A parking system accepts only plates of the form two uppercase letters followed by four digits, for example TN0924. Read the plate and print valid when it is exactly 6 characters long, starts with two uppercase letters and ends with four digits; otherwise print invalid.

Input Format:
A single line containing one plate token without spaces (letters and digits only).

Output Format:
Print one line: valid or invalid.

Constraints:
1 <= length of plate <= 10
questions.inputconstrains: 1 <= length of plate <= 10, letters and digits only
